title: Send an action goal
description: Send a goal to the /drive_distance action, served by the drive-distance server, to move one metre and receive its final result. The server controls the actual simulated robot.
steps: Use action list, action type /drive_distance and interface show ros2learn_interfaces/action/DriveDistance.
Send DriveDistance.Goal with distance = 1.0.
When accepted, request get_result_async and inspect result.success and result.final_distance.
hints: DriveDistance is our educational custom interface, not a standard ROS action.
send_goal_async resolves to a goal handle, not directly to the final result.
In the accepted callback: future.result().get_result_async().add_done_callback(on_result).

content.title: Send an action goal
content.description: Send a goal to the /drive_distance action, served by the drive-distance server, to move one metre and receive its final result. The server controls the actual simulated robot.
steps: Use action list, action type /drive_distance and interface show ros2learn_interfaces/action/DriveDistance.
Create Action::Goal with distance = 1.0 and send it with async_send_goal(goal, options).
Register goal_response_callback and result_callback in SendGoalOptions. Inspect result.code, result.result->success and result.result->final_distance.
hints: DriveDistance is a custom educational action, not a standard ROS action.
Goal acceptance and completion are separate callbacks. A null goal handle means rejection.
Create rclcpp_action::Client<Action>::SendGoalOptions and set result_callback before async_send_goal.
